answer_1.quote: We applied SC-GPT, a fine-tuned language model conditioned on the dialog acts, to paraphrase the sentences as data augmentation.

answer_4.quote: To ensure the quality of our augmented test set, we conduct human annotation on 1,000 sampled utterances in each augmented test set of MultiWOZ. We ask annotators to check whether our augmented utterances are reasonable and our auto-detected value annotations are correct (two true-or-false questions).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators check if augmented utterances are reasonable and auto-detected value annotations are correct, with method-specific criteria: for TP and SD, meaning and dialog acts unchanged; for WP, slot name same; for SR, similarity of pronunciation.
